meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'смотреть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'we shall see', paired with 'смотреть'.

meanings.en: to become hungry, work up an appetite
meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'голодаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'got hungry', paired with 'голодать'.

examples.trans: The guests became very hungry.
After the walk we were hungry.
Our guests have gotten very hungry.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'делать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'делать'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'еденный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('lunch, midday').

meanings.en: to appear, to show up, to turn up
